listing.name: Secrets of the Frontier
listing.summary: Secrets of the Frontier is a mod focused on narrative content around several Domain-era AI experiments conducted in the Persean Sector.
listing.aiSummary: Adds narrative content centered on Domain-era AI experiments, new tactical combat objectives and environments, and a station-building mechanic.

description:
Secrets of the Frontier requires LunaLib as of 0.14.5!!!

Secrets of the Frontier is a mod focused on narrative content around several Domain-era AI experiments conducted in the Persean Sector. It also adds additional content to the game's tactical layer through more scenic environments and new combat objectives, and adds a simple station-building mechanic to the campaign layer.

This mod is still in active development, and is not complete in terms of features or narrative. It's comprised of several modules that can be individually toggled on or off. The mod is best experienced on a normally-sized sector without Nexerelin's random sector option.

Click the big banner to download. Requires LazyLib, GraphicsLib, MagicLib AND LunaLib.

All of the current modules in the prerelease can be added midway through a campaign and still function (encounters typically generated at the start of the campaign will spawn in immediately)
Turning off Watcher Beyond the Walls mid-campaign may cause issues.

If you find any bugs, do mention them to me!

Secrets of the Frontier is currently my main modding focus but despite that, a full release is most likely far off. Teasers may end up posted here.

Required mods:
LazyLib
GraphicsLib
MagicLib
LunaLib

Highly recommended mods:
Combat Chatter - this mod's unique officers come with special chatter!

Some add-ons and crossovers:
Second-in-Command - by Lukas04, which combined with SotF allow you to employ Sierra as an executive officer to gain fleet-wide boons of witchcraft.
Dustkeeper XO - by shmone-else, which adds a Dustkeeper aptitude to Second-in-Command
Secrets Of The Frontier - Bonus Combat Objectives - by NikoTheGuyDude, which adds several new objectives to the Tactical Expansion module of SotF
Random Assortment of Things - by Lukas04, a customizable megamod that also adds a new ship for Sierra with its Abyssal Depths module
Phillip Andrada Gas Station Manager - by WMGreywind, a high-effort Diktat meme overhaul with unique Sierra interactions and an Askonia mini-quest involving a SotF character

Modules
Secrets of the Frontier comes as several modules that can be individually turned on and off, listed:
Watcher Beyond The Walls: Adds narrative content including quests and special encounters centered around a set of Domain-era AI projects.
- Make contact with the Dustkeeper Contingency, a sect of rogue guardians trying to save humanity.
- Befriend Sierra, an interdimensional AI companion with a penchant for music and dance.
- Play "The Haunted", a custom start where you're a former pirate warlord with gnawing guilt and a relentless pursuer
- Play "Child of the Lake", a custom start who you are served dutifully by an occult technological heirloom who grants you abilities almost like black magic

- Currently features the following quests/encounters:

Spoiler
- A Promise
- A Memory
- Wayward Star

- Hope for Hallowhall
- Legacy of Hypnos

- Light of the Lake (Haunted start only)

Tactical Expansion: Enhances the combat layer of the game.
-Adds two new objective types, the Emplacement/Siegeworks Uplink and Hyperwave Transmitter, alongside their Remnant versions.

-Visual enhancements to battlefield backgrounds, including visible jump-points and multiple planets.

-Context-based battle generation. Some aspects of combat such as objectives change depending on where you're fighting.

Frontier Development: Adds a constructable orbital habitat to stable locations that grants a hazard reduction to in-system colonies.
-Can be upgraded into an outpost, which acts as a low-hazard colony but loses the hazard reduction and has a soft-cap on its growth.

Screenshots - Spoiler Free

Spoiler

Screenshots - Spoilers
(subject to change)

Spoiler

Glory to the Contingency. Only by our sacrifice can humanity arise from its dark age.

Click here to view the changelog on GitHub

Credits
- Fractal Softworks, duh
- Inventor Racccoon (me), for more-or-less everything not done by someone else mentioned here
- Nia - Vow, Covenant, Memoir, VFX
- Selkie - Respite, Anamnesis, vector engines,
- Lortus - Siegeworks emplacements
- Quacken - Warhorn
- Gwyvern - mystery unimplemented sprite
- SnazzyPantsMcGee - 2 mystery unimplemented sprites, majority of Cult of the Daydream tech
- Kirbo - Anapausis, Polychronios, Doxology, Pledge
- Nes - paintjob sprites and some phase glows
- Pyrophage - Siegeworks hangar concept,
- AxleMC131 - Parapet/Peon, Lethargy Autolance

- Lukas04 - Witchcraft SiC aptitude, Haunted/COTL visual code,
- Starficz - vector engine code
- Estudio Cafofo for music
- Dark.Revenant for some bits of the battle creation plugin for cosmetics and battlefield sizes

For Modders - Tactical Expansion mod support

Spoiler
Secrets of the Frontier's Tactical Expansion module now supports additions from other mods. At present, this means 3 things:
- Mods can add new objective spawns to SotF battle objective spawning. This can be used either to cause objectives to spawn due to specific system themes, or to spawn their own custom objectives.
- Mods can add new ship variants to the lists used by SotF's emplacement objective
- Mods can add factions to the list that will employ remote AI core captains when they receive droneship reinforcements from battle objectives (akin to a player with the Automated Ships skill)

All mod compatibility is handled by several mergeable .csv files, located at data/config/sotf and employed by the mod itself for its standard behavior. There's a modder_instructions.txt file included, which explains each spreadsheet's function and the requirements/effects of each column in detail.

releases.changelogNotes:
- New Cult of the Daydream ship: Rose-class interdictor
   - An elite destroyer specializing in bombarding, controlling and erasing hostiles from afar
   - Spite is the armor of beauty, make the enemy suffer!
   - Obtained similarly to other CotD designs; loading a Child of the Lake save will automatically add Rose-class to known blueprints
- New Dustkeeper flagships: Doxology-class heavy frigate and Polychronios-class & Anapausis-class cruisers
   - Doxology: an overengineered teleporting menace with too many guns
   - Polychronios: a disruptive support ship with an EWAR focus
   - Anapausis: a time-accelerated hunter-killer rewarding strategic use of its charged system
   - All 3 are used as the leader of smaller Dustkeeper fleets
   - You can order these from Inadvertent when he has spare forge slots and you have enough reputation with him
   - Also, one guaranteed recoverable derelict of each will appear in high-danger Remnant systems

- Added Thrice-Speared "support" category traits. These can only spawn once you reach level 10 and have a decent-sized (120DP) fleet, and have wide-reaching effects
- New Thrice-Speared traits:
   - Decaying Scourge (offense): Can periodically lash a nearby ship, dealing 8% of its current hull value as damage over time. Also halts the target. Versus nanite mimics and reflections, also overloads for 2s and deals an additional 8% of current hull instantly
   - Elegy of Opis (support): Gain a charge for each dead ally ship, at 3 charges the next ally that would be destroyed instead enters an undying rage, regaining 35% hull but decaying over time
   - Hands of the Drowned (support): Passively spawns waves of gravitic mines that deal damage and pull in their victims
   - reality_breaker (support): NullPointerException (KILL IT KILL IT KILL IT)
   - The Perfect Storm (support): Every 50 seconds, overloads ALL player-side ships for 3 seconds unless they are venting or phased (non-player ships will try to use this to dodge the overload)

- Changes to anti-ship cannon strikes (i.e. Leviathan's Bane & some add-on mod ASCs):
   - Targets should react more naturally to the incoming attack (thanks zoeythegirlgal for the original code!)
   - Ships will now start turning around during the lockon sequence if they have front shields
   - Replaced lock-on rings with a text display and targeting indicator on affected ships (LIDAR beam is also still present). The text display is visible near the center of the screen if the target is the player's ship and they're panned away
   - Added a UI message when a player-side ship is targeted by an anti-ship cannon

- Concord - Soulbond: reduced OP cost from 10/15 des/cru to 8/12
- New Pledge sprite by Kirbo (thanks so much!!!!)
- New Sierra conversation topics: Sirius, Oneslaught, Threat, Third Strike, Dweller

- New Respite sprite by Selkie and Snazzy (THANKS :)!!!)
- Fixed Cyberwarfare Suite cooldown reduction and penetration stats being affected by each other's modifiers resulting in a net near-zero change
- Cyberwarfare Suite cooldown reduction listed value nerfed (25% > 15%), actual effect buffed (2.5% > 15%)
- Wendigo and Courser infex changed from Annex to "Infix" to denote their special status as hunter-killers
- Mia's Star: Increased distance from core, trace volatiles to Hallowhall (this is partly a nerf - can no longer use soil nanites)
- Rigging-Echo-Inadvertent is now added as a contact when met so he appears in the intel tab. Dustkeeper contacts (ie just him right now) don't count towards the player's max contacts
- Dustkeeper fleet flagships are now more likely to be recoverable after battle with their fleets or burnouts
- Wendigo's Ether Wolves fleet is now bigger
- Added 2 new generic Dustkeeper portraits, Indigo and Orange. Yellow recruitable sliver is now orange on new saves
- Increased priority of Dustkeeper Burnout comm dialogue so they're less likely to be overriden
- Can now ask Cerulean Faithful to fix your Tri-Tachyon reputation

- Felcesis is now primarily referred to as "The Thrice-Speared"
- Thrice-Speared: rebalanced earlygame difficulty rampup (now 1 trait until player has 40dp of ships, fewer daydream skills until 60dp, 2 traits until 100dp)
- Thrice-Speared: invasion UI is now Sirius-flavored while playing Child of the Lake
- Rebalanced support traits that were in the files but didn't appear normally. Added a toggle to replace the reality_breaker crashcode with an equivalent non-crash punishment
- Dear Dotty: can no longer be rolled as a trait until player is level 5
- Revenant Host: replaced Wolves and Wardens with approximately equivalent DP of Thorns
- The Haunted: added unique music to the ending dialogue sequence

- Polarized Nanorepair skill: now soft-caps the regen at 450/850/1250/1650 armor (e.g 1650 armor capital regens armor at rate of 1%/s, 3300 capital regens 0.5%/s). With Tahlan Shipworks, halved regen rate on ships with Hel Plating or Hel Carapace (sorry. Or you're welcome. It depends on if you play more CotL or Haunted, really)
- Thorn: increased Hypnagogic Incursion flux dissipation boost (+100% base, decaying > +200% base, decaying)
- Daydream Systems Engineering: now provides immunity to solar coronae and similar hazards, ala s-modded Solar Shielding
- Mercy Multilance (beams and bolts): Reduced range (1000 > 700). TLDR for below changes: nerfed performance against armor and small ships
- Mercy Multilance (beams): Now fires 5 beams (was 4) with increased spread. Total damage unchanged, effective armor penetration nerf. Increased base armor shred, reduced stacking (40 + 20 per extra multilance > 50 + 10). Fixed bug where the last stack of armor shred would never expire
- Mercy Multilance (bolts): Now fires 24 bolts for total of 2400 fragmentation damage (was 12 bolts for 600 energy). No longer applies EMP damage (was 600). Slightly widened bolt spread
- Chalice Resonance Cage: Increased flux per shot (1500 > 2250, flux efficiency including bolts ~0.77 > 1.15)
- Daydream drone replicators: reduced max drones active (6 > 4), barb mount is still 2
- Drones fired using the system of Random Assortment of Things' Gilgamesh now self-destruct after 15 seconds (sorry)

- Child of the Lake: Added a 1.2x multiplier to the deployment point cost of all the player's ships. There's a LunaLib setting to adjust this (range 1x-3x, 1x means no penalty)
- CotL: If the enemy fleet has no mimicable ships (even if it doesn't fit the criteria for a special countermeasure), Sirius will spawn a custom-fitted Champion reflection
- CotL: Removed "original captain must be level 8 or lower" condition for spawning echoes from ships
- CotL: Friendly ships no longer create echoes by default
- CotL: New T4 upgrade, "No Rest For The Wicked": Friendly ships dying at any range create echoes that linger for twice as long. Mimics created by these echoes only take up 50% of the usual mimic capacity and don't suffer the normal mimic stat penalties
- CotL: non-reflection mimics no longer have combat chatter
- CotL: Added monomolecular blade form for Sirius (available during certain vanilla dialogues)

- Fixed Nexerelin backgrounds applying to Haunted/CotL custom starts sometimes (sorry, it caused weird bugs)
- Fixed being able to give Wendigo (Courser Hunt interaction) the Hypnos data if you did Hypnos for them/Inad and thus they already have the data
- Fixed certain interactions with Hypnos-Annex-Barrow incorrectly reducing reputation with Dauntless-Annex-Barrow
- Fixed Blithe/Seraph fleets failing to respawn if Hallowhall, um, "ceases to exist inside Mia's Star" (e.g it was teleported out using Ind.Evo)
- Fixed Seraph's chip being able to drop from the ODS Last Light when fought
- Fixed Dustkeeper fleet commanders flying Reposes not being oldguards
- Fixed Cyberwarfare Protocols being able to target wisps
- Fixed Lethargy/Reckoner beams being able to hit a ship's own modules
- Fixed Mercy on-hit armor effectiveness reduction not fully expiring
- Fixed Revenant Host ships not being nanite-synthesized (i.e. dark and spooky)
- Fixed being able to cast Invoke Her Blessing on friendly expiring mimics if also hovering over an echo
- Fixed inverted range check on Dustkeeper betrayal taking over allied autoships and possible concurrent modification exception
